project.name: Locopilot Monitoring System
project.description: CCTV-based activity monitoring system for Indian railway locomotive pilots and assistant loco pilots that combines a classical computer-vision pipeline (YOLOv8 + pose estimation + rule-based detectors) with a Qwen2.5-VL VLM verification layer to detect and report safety-critical cabin activities such as sleeping, cell-phone use, writing, and eating. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.

nodes.name: mind_diversion_suppression.py
nodes.summary: Pure-function rules that suppress mind-diversion alerts when the pilot is plausibly engaged in legitimate logbook/writing work (book detected, recent writing activity within grace window).
nodes.languageNotes: Extracted byte-identically from LocopilotActivityMonitor to keep grep-able reason strings stable for ops.

nodes.name: should_suppress_mind_diversion
nodes.summary: Returns (suppress, reason) tuple; checks active writing activity, book detection near the person, and recent writing within a grace window to silence transient mind-diversion FPs.

nodes.name: writing_fallbacks.py
nodes.summary: Fallback writing detectors used when the primary trajectory classifier is uncertain: wrist-proximity-to-book and book-plus-posture heuristics for logbook activity.

nodes.name: WritingFallbackThresholds
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding tunable thresholds (consecutive-frame counts, distance margins, posture angles) for the writing fallback detectors.

nodes.name: detect_writing_by_wrist_proximity
nodes.summary: Detects writing by checking wrist-to-book IoU/proximity over consecutive frames; uses geometry helpers to compute overlap with a configurable margin.

nodes.name: detect_writing_by_book_and_posture
nodes.summary: Pose-only fallback: flags writing when a book is detected near the person and the head/torso pose matches a downward writing posture.

nodes.name: gates.py
nodes.summary: Single source of truth for the train-stopped suppression gate: zeroes both aggregated and per-person activity flags and fires detector reset hooks so downstream consumers stay consistent (ARCH-08b).
nodes.languageNotes: microsleep and cell_phone are intentionally excluded from suppression — they remain safety-critical at stations.

nodes.name: apply_train_stopped_suppression
nodes.summary: Mutates aggregated booleans and per-person activity dicts to zero out non-safety-critical activities when the train is STOPPED; invokes detector on_suppressed hooks to clear per-detector counters.

nodes.name: clip_writer.py

nodes.name: save_video_clip
nodes.summary: Writes a buffered list of annotated frames to disk via OpenCV VideoWriter at the source fps.

nodes.name: ModelLoader

nodes.name: YOLOHandler
nodes.summary: Encapsulates YOLO object + pose inference: batch detection across persons, per-detector confidence thresholds, ROI cropping around pose keypoints, and validation helpers for bag/book false-positive suppression.

nodes.name: frame_sampling.py

nodes.name: sample_video_frames
nodes.summary: Samples frames from a video at the configured stride (target_fps / source_fps) within an optional start/end range, returning frames and their precise timestamps.

nodes.name: coordination.py
nodes.summary: Hand-gesture coordination gate: requires both LP and ALP to have gestured within a configurable window before flagging single-person gesture activity.

nodes.name: check_hand_gesture_coordination
nodes.summary: Returns a coordination verdict (e.g. alp_only / lp_only / both / none) for hand gestures, comparing recent gesture timestamps across the LP and ALP person indices.

nodes.name: per_person_state.py
nodes.summary: Per-person consecutive-frame counters with grace-period reset and stale-entry cleanup; the temporal filter underneath the activity registry's required_consecutive rules.

nodes.name: PerPersonState
nodes.summary: Maintains per-person consecutive-frame counters, last-seen timestamps, and grace-period resets; update_consecutive returns True when the threshold is crossed, cleanup_stale evicts inactive person indices.

nodes.name: pose_checks.py
nodes.summary: Small pure helpers used by detectors: hands-below-shoulders check and generic hand/object interaction proximity test.

nodes.name: check_hands_below_shoulders
nodes.summary: Returns True when both wrists are vertically below their corresponding shoulders by a configurable margin — a posture precondition for writing/eating.

nodes.name: check_hand_object_interaction
nodes.summary: Returns True when a wrist keypoint is within a configurable margin of an object bbox — generic hand-on-object proximity check.

nodes.name: pose_validators.py
nodes.summary: Pose-landmark sanity checks: visible-keypoint count, anatomical consistency (e.g. inverted person), and landmark-stability history mutation.

nodes.name: validate_pose_landmarks
nodes.summary: Validates that enough pose landmarks are visible above a confidence threshold before downstream detectors trust the pose.

nodes.name: validate_anatomical_consistency
nodes.summary: Rejects inverted/twisted poses (head below hips, etc.) that produce phantom activity flags on noisy detections.

nodes.name: check_landmark_stability
nodes.summary: Mutates an in-place landmark history dict, returning True when consecutive landmarks have been stable within tolerance — gates jitter-induced FPs.

nodes.name: video_io.py

nodes.name: draw_mediapipe_outputs

nodes.name: test_mind_diversion_suppression.py

nodes.name: test_per_person_state.py

nodes.name: test_pose_validators.py

nodes.name: test_writing_fallbacks.py

nodes.name: S3UploadService
nodes.summary: Boto3 S3 client wrapper exposing upload_file and upload_multiple_files, used by the controller to push evidence artifacts to the customer's evidence bucket after every successful run.

nodes.name: get_s3_upload_service
nodes.summary: Singleton accessor for the S3UploadService used by the video controller after a run completes.

nodes.summary: Singleton orchestrator that turns a saved video plus crew metadata into a run directory containing activities.json, evidence clips, and frames. It is the boundary between the FastAPI request layer and the classical-CV detector subsystem.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.summary: Central pydantic-settings class loading .env / .env.production. Defines every detection flag (POSE_MODEL, YOLO_ALWAYS_PREPROCESS, ZONE_SUPPRESSION_ENABLED, etc.), train-motion thresholds, VLM verifier knobs, MinIO/S3 credentials, and API key gates. Three model_validator hooks enforce overlap-window math, flag compatibility (e.g. rtmpose requires rtmlib), and non-empty MinIO credentials in production.

nodes.name: get_settings
nodes.summary: LRU-cached accessor returning the shared Settings instance — the canonical way every module reads configuration.

nodes.name: url_safety.py
nodes.summary: SSRF defense for user-supplied videoUrl. Resolves the host, rejects file://, RFC1918, loopback, link-local, AWS metadata, and other reserved ranges, and enforces an optional allowlist before any download is attempted.

nodes.name: URLNotAllowed
nodes.summary: Lightweight exception raised by validate_external_url when a supplied URL fails any safety check; controller catches it and converts to HTTP 400.

nodes.name: _is_blocked_ip
nodes.summary: Predicate that returns True for any IP in loopback, private, link-local, multicast, reserved, or the EC2 metadata 169.254/16 range — blocking SSRF targets that resolve to internal infrastructure.

nodes.name: validate_external_url
nodes.summary: Public SSRF gatekeeper called from the controller. Rejects empty inputs, non-http(s) schemes, off-allowlist hosts, DNS failures, and hosts whose resolved IP is blocked by _is_blocked_ip. Raises URLNotAllowed on any failure so the caller can map it to HTTP 400.

nodes.name: test_post_verifier_merge.py
nodes.summary: Regression tests covering the VLM-verify-before-grouping pipeline ordering. Drives a stub VLM service through three scenarios (flag off legacy ordering, flag on new ordering, co-merged FP drop while preserving TP) to lock in the post-verifier merge contract.

nodes.name: test_flag_off_preserves_legacy_ordering
nodes.summary: Verifies that when the post-verifier flag is off the verifier still runs after grouping, preserving the legacy ordering and the activities list shape.

nodes.name: test_flag_on_runs_verify_before_group
nodes.summary: Asserts the verifier is invoked before concurrent-activity grouping when the new flag is on so co-merged FPs can be dropped before they bias the grouped output.

nodes.name: test_flag_on_drops_co_merged_fp_keeps_tp
nodes.summary: End-to-end test ensuring that with the flag on, a FALSE_POSITIVE merged into a TRUE_POSITIVE group is dropped without removing the TP — the central bug fix the post-verifier-merge change exists to enable.

nodes.name: test_url_safety.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the SSRF defense in app/utils/url_safety.py — checks rejection of AWS metadata IP, localhost, RFC1918 ranges, file://, off-allowlist hosts, DNS failures, and acceptance of legitimately-resolving allowlist hosts.

nodes.name: test_rejects_aws_metadata_ip
nodes.summary: Confirms a URL whose host resolves to 169.254.169.254 (AWS EC2 metadata endpoint) is rejected by validate_external_url.

nodes.name: test_rejects_extended_blocked_ranges
nodes.summary: Parametrised test covering the wider set of blocked CIDR ranges (loopback, multicast, reserved) used by _is_blocked_ip.

nodes.name: test_accepts_allowed_host_resolving_publicly
nodes.summary: Positive-path test verifying that an allowlisted host resolving to a normal public IP is accepted by validate_external_url.

nodes.name: test_settings_validator.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the Settings model_validator hooks in app/utils/config.py — covers YOLO weights existence checks, rtmpose dependency validation, and MinIO credential requirements that differ between development and production environments.

nodes.name: test_nonexistent_yolo_weights_rejected
nodes.summary: Verifies that the Settings validator rejects absolute YOLO weight paths that don't exist on disk so the service fails fast at startup rather than at first inference.

nodes.name: test_rtmpose_without_rtmlib_rejected
nodes.summary: Asserts the flag-compatibility validator refuses to construct Settings when POSE_MODEL=rtmpose but rtmlib is not importable.

nodes.name: test_production_with_empty_minio_credentials_rejected
nodes.summary: Confirms the production-only validator rejects empty MinIO credentials so deployments cannot accidentally boot with anonymous-bucket assumptions.

nodes.name: test_production_with_real_credentials_ok
nodes.summary: Positive-path test verifying that a production Settings instance constructs cleanly when both access_key and secret_key are populated.

nodes.name: test_default_minio_credentials_are_not_hardcoded_secrets
nodes.summary: Guard test ensuring that the default Settings values for MinIO credentials are empty strings rather than well-known minioadmin defaults, preventing accidental shipped secrets.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package init for the controllers layer that re-exports the FastAPI video router from video_controller.
nodes.languageNotes: Python package barrel that exposes the controller's router symbol to app.main.

nodes.name: video_controller.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI controller defining every video-processing endpoint: synchronous /api/v1/video/process-and-upload pipeline, async job queue routes (/api/video/jobs/*), media serving, and health checks. Centralizes input validation, GPU-slot admission control, MinIO download/upload coordination, VLM verification hook, and external-API posting.
nodes.languageNotes: Single 1425-line module of 14 router functions; the core `_run_video_pipeline` is 670 lines and orchestrates the full Pipeline-1 + VLM + S3 + external-API flow.

nodes.name: sanitize_identifier
nodes.summary: Strict regex-based sanitizer for tripId / division / sub-folder identifiers; rejects characters outside [A-Za-z0-9_-] and enforces a max length to block path-traversal and injection attacks.

nodes.name: enforce_max_upload_size
nodes.summary: FastAPI dependency that rejects uploads whose Content-Length header exceeds the configured maximum video size, returning HTTP 413 before bytes are read.

nodes.name: require_api_key
nodes.summary: FastAPI dependency that enforces the X-API-Key header against the configured MEDIA_API_KEY using a constant-time HMAC compare; logs a rollout-mode warning when no key is set.

nodes.name: _run_video_pipeline
nodes.summary: Core 670-line orchestrator for a single video request. Validates inputs, downloads the source (multipart upload or MinIO URL), acquires a GPU slot via GPUResourceManager, runs Pipeline-1 (activity detection), invokes the VLM verifier when enabled, performs concurrent-activity grouping, uploads clips/frames to S3, and posts violations to the external mindcoinapps API.
nodes.languageNotes: 20-parameter async function with deeply nested try/except branches; touches every singleton service in the codebase.

nodes.name: process_video
nodes.summary: Legacy POST /api/v1/video/process route that accepts multipart form fields and delegates to _run_video_pipeline without the external-API upload step (CVVR posting disabled).

nodes.name: get_processing_status
nodes.summary: GET /api/v1/video/status/{run_id} endpoint that validates the run_id against a strict regex and returns the on-disk processing status for a previously launched run.

nodes.name: get_run_media
nodes.summary: GET /api/jobs/{run_id}/media/{filename} endpoint that safely serves evidence clips and frames. Validates run_id with regex, enforces a common-path traversal check, supports HTTP Range requests for video streaming, and gates access via MEDIA_API_KEY.

nodes.name: process_and_upload_video
nodes.summary: POST /api/v1/video/process-and-upload route — the production multipart entry point. Delegates to _run_video_pipeline with upload_to_external_api=True so violations are posted to mindcoinapps after S3 upload.

nodes.name: submit_video_job
nodes.summary: POST /api/video/jobs endpoint that enqueues a JobSubmitRequest into the 3-worker JobManager queue after verifying the input video path exists, returning a JobSubmitResponse with the queue position.

nodes.name: get_job_status
nodes.summary: GET /api/video/jobs/{job_id} endpoint returning the current JobStatusResponse including progress, queue position, and elapsed processing time.

nodes.name: get_job_result
nodes.summary: GET /api/video/jobs/{job_id}/result endpoint that returns the final JobResultResponse for completed jobs and HTTP 409 if the job is still running.

nodes.name: cancel_job
nodes.summary: POST /api/video/jobs/{job_id}/cancel endpoint that requests cancellation through JobManager.cancel_job, idempotently handling already-completed or already-cancelled jobs.

nodes.name: get_queue_status
nodes.summary: GET /api/video/queue/status endpoint returning current queue depth, active jobs, max workers, and capacity flags from JobManager.

nodes.languageNotes: Uses FastAPI lifespan async context manager (Starlette 0.26+) for startup/shutdown.

nodes.name: print_startup_banner
nodes.summary: Logs a multi-line banner at boot summarizing GPU availability, model paths, MAX_CONCURRENT_VIDEOS, MinIO endpoint, and VLM verifier enable state for operational visibility.

nodes.name: process_video_job

nodes.name: lifespan
nodes.summary: FastAPI lifespan async context manager that initializes GPUResourceManager (lazy YOLO/pose load), spawns JobManager workers, kicks off a background DLQ drain task, and gracefully shuts down all of them on exit.

nodes.name: http_exception_handler
nodes.summary: Global FastAPI HTTPException handler that returns a uniform JSON error envelope and scrubs sensitive fields before logging.

nodes.name: validation_exception_handler
nodes.summary: RequestValidationError handler that strips raw input values from pydantic error payloads before returning them, preventing leakage of secrets posted to the API.

nodes.name: general_exception_handler
nodes.summary: Catch-all exception handler that logs the traceback server-side and returns a sanitized HTTP 500 message to the client.

nodes.name: health
nodes.summary: GET /health endpoint returning service status, GPU manager state, JobManager queue stats, and VLM verifier reachability for liveness/readiness checks.

nodes.name: get_gpu_status
nodes.summary: GET /gpu/status endpoint returning detailed GPU memory usage, active concurrent video count, and OOM recovery counters from GPUResourceManager.

nodes.name: job_models.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic models and the JobStatus enum used by JobManager and the controller's job endpoints — Job dataclass plus request/response DTOs for submit, status, result, cancel, and queue-status routes.

nodes.name: JobStatus
nodes.summary: String enum of lifecycle states (queued, processing, completed, failed, cancelled, cancel_requested) used to drive JobManager state transitions and API responses.

nodes.name: Job
nodes.summary: Core Job dataclass holding job_id, payload, status, queue position, progress percentage, timestamps, error info, and final result — the central in-memory unit JobManager manipulates.

nodes.name: JobSubmitRequest
nodes.summary: Pydantic request model for POST /api/video/jobs containing the video path, tripId, division, crew identifiers, and pipeline flags such as useMultiprocessing.

nodes.name: JobSubmitResponse

nodes.name: __init__.py

nodes.name: activity_detection_service.py
nodes.summary: Service wrapping the LocopilotActivityMonitor detector. Exposes mock and real detection paths and dispatches between single-process and multi-process video processing based on the request flag.

nodes.name: ActivityDetectionService
nodes.summary: Coordinates classical-CV activity detection. Owns the LocopilotActivityMonitor instance, exposes detect_activities_mock for synthetic results, and runs real detection either single-process or via the two-pass multiprocessing orchestrator.

nodes.name: dlq.py
nodes.summary: Filesystem-backed dead-letter queue for failed external-API POST attempts. Writes JSON records (with sensitive headers stripped) under a configurable directory, evicts oldest records when the cap is exceeded, and offers a drain function that replays them with backoff and attempt tracking.

nodes.name: write_dlq
nodes.summary: Persists a failed POST attempt (URL, payload, headers, error reason) as a JSON record on disk, scrubbing sensitive headers, enforcing free-disk-space and record-count caps, and rotating the oldest entries when needed.

nodes.name: drain_dlq
nodes.summary: Background drain loop that lists pending DLQ files, re-posts them via the provided repost callback, increments attempt counts on failure, and deletes records on success.

nodes.name: _default_repost
nodes.summary: Default HTTP repost implementation used when draining the DLQ — issues a POST with the original payload and headers and returns success only on 2xx responses.

nodes.name: _evict_oldest_if_over_cap
nodes.summary: Disk-pressure eviction helper that removes the oldest DLQ records once the per-directory cap (count or bytes) is exceeded, keeping unbounded growth in check.

nodes.name: external_api_service.py
nodes.summary: Stateful HTTP client that posts verified violations and no-event heartbeats to the mindcoinapps cvvr/cvvrTripViolations/addUpdateBulk endpoint. Implements retry-with-backoff, idempotency-key derivation, payload transformation, deduplication, and DLQ fallback on persistent failure.

nodes.name: ExternalAPIService
nodes.summary: Singleton HTTP client that transforms activities into violation payloads, posts them with retry+idempotency to mindcoinapps, deduplicates against prior posts, falls back to the DLQ on hard failures, and normalizes division strings.

nodes.name: get_external_api_service
nodes.summary: Thread-safe double-checked-locking singleton accessor for the ExternalAPIService instance shared across the FastAPI process.

nodes.name: _compute_idempotency_key
nodes.summary: Derives a stable idempotency key from tripId plus a sorted-violation digest so retries don't double-post the same set of events to the mindcoinapps API.

nodes.name: gpu_resource_manager.py
nodes.summary: Per-process singleton enforcing the MAX_CONCURRENT_VIDEOS GPU-slot cap. Lazily loads YOLO and pose models, tracks active inference jobs, exposes acquire/try_enqueue admission control, and handles CUDA OOM by clearing caches and reducing batch size.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses __new__ + threading.Lock for thread-safe singleton; pinned to one Gunicorn worker (C-1 rule).

nodes.name: GPUResourceManager
nodes.summary: Singleton owning the YOLO+pose model handles, a semaphore for concurrent inference, OOM recovery logic, memory health checks, and a try_enqueue admission API used by the controller. The per-process cap is the architectural reason gunicorn is pinned to workers=1.

nodes.name: get_gpu_resource_manager
nodes.summary: Thread-safe singleton accessor returning the per-process GPUResourceManager instance, lazily creating it on first call.

nodes.name: image_preprocessing_service.py
nodes.summary: OpenCV-based frame preprocessor used before pose detection. Applies bilateral filtering, CLAHE contrast enhancement, optional gamma correction, unsharp masking, and light noise reduction; also exposes a quality detector that gates preprocessing.

nodes.name: ImagePreprocessingService
nodes.summary: Encapsulates the bilateral-filter + CLAHE + optional gamma/unsharp/noise-reduction pipeline applied to every frame when YOLO_ALWAYS_PREPROCESS is on. Includes a detect_image_quality heuristic to skip preprocessing on already-clean frames.

nodes.name: job_manager.py
nodes.summary: Singleton job queue with 3 background workers serving the /api/video/jobs endpoints. Manages queued/processing/completed jobs, evicts oldest completed entries to cap memory, supports cooperative cancellation, and integrates with GPUResourceManager admission.

nodes.name: JobManager
nodes.summary: Thread-safe singleton that maintains the in-memory job dict, an asyncio-compatible queue, worker tasks, and lifecycle hooks (start_workers, stop_workers, shutdown). Each worker pulls a Job, dispatches it to the registered process_job callback, and tracks progress/result.

nodes.name: __init__.py

nodes.languageNotes: Python package init acting as a barrel for the core detection subsystem.

nodes.name: activity_registry.py

nodes.languageNotes: Acts as a settings-driven registry; rebuild_activity_registry() lets tests mutate Settings and rebuild the registry at runtime.

nodes.name: ActivityConfig
nodes.summary: Dataclass capturing per-activity tuning knobs: type_code, evidence_rule, triggering_role, min_duration, required_consecutive, grace_frames, margins, and proximity windows.

nodes.name: _build_activity_registry
nodes.summary: Constructs the canonical ACTIVITY_REGISTRY dict from pydantic Settings, instantiating one ActivityConfig per safety-critical activity (sleep, microsleep, cell_phone, gestures, writing, packing_bags, mind_diversion, eating_drinking, no_person_detected).

nodes.name: rebuild_activity_registry
nodes.summary: Test-facing helper that rebuilds the ACTIVITY_REGISTRY in place when Settings change, so downstream consumers see the new tuning knobs.

nodes.name: is_activity_enabled
nodes.summary: Returns whether a given activity is enabled in current Settings; thin wrapper over settings.is_activity_enabled with safe-default fallback.

nodes.name: activity_tracker.py
nodes.summary: Temporal state machine that promotes raw per-frame detections into confirmed activities using required-consecutive frames, grace counters, and per-person tracking; re-exports ActivityConfig from activity_registry.
nodes.languageNotes: Maintains per-person consecutive/grace counters with defaultdict; finalize_all_activities flushes still-open intervals at end-of-video.

nodes.name: ActivityState
nodes.summary: Serializable per-activity interval state: active flag, start_time, frame counts, captured frames, person_roles, and to_dict/from_dict helpers for persistence.

nodes.name: ActivityTracker
nodes.summary: Central temporal-filtering engine: tracks per-activity start/end transitions, per-person consecutive detection counters, applies min_duration/required_consecutive thresholds, and finalizes activity intervals into output records.

nodes.name: evidence_manager.py
nodes.summary: Manages the run-directory layout and produces all on-disk evidence artifacts: video clips (via cv2 + ffmpeg H.264 re-encode), JPEG keyframes, annotated frames, and activities.json summary reports.
nodes.languageNotes: Wraps subprocess calls to ffmpeg for clip extraction/re-encoding and cv2 for image/video writing; deliberately fails open and logs warnings on missing toolchain.

nodes.name: EvidenceManager
nodes.summary: Owns run-directory creation and all evidence artifacts: extract_video_segment (ffmpeg cut), reencode_to_h264, save_video_clip, save_activity_image(_from_video), save_annotated_frame, save_activities_json, and summary report generation.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package initializer re-exporting activity and video pydantic models so callers can import directly from app.models.

nodes.name: activity_models.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic models for activity records (ActivityModel, EvidenceModel, PersonRoleModel) plus a runtime check that the ActivityType enum stays consistent with ACTIVITY_REGISTRY (single-source-of-truth invariant).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses _build_activity_type_enum_members + _assert_enum_matches_registry to fail fast at import time if the registry and enum drift.

nodes.name: _build_activity_type_enum_members
nodes.summary: Derives the ActivityType IntEnum member set from ACTIVITY_REGISTRY so the public enum is always in sync with the registry.

nodes.name: _assert_enum_matches_registry
nodes.summary: Import-time invariant check: raises RuntimeError if any ActivityType enum member's code disagrees with the corresponding ACTIVITY_REGISTRY entry.

nodes.name: ActivityModel
nodes.summary: Pydantic schema for a single activity record persisted in activities.json: tripId, activityType, timing, crew roles, evidence references, and clip/image paths.

nodes.name: PersonRoleModel
nodes.summary: Per-person role embedding on an activity: personIndex, role/roleName (LP/ALP), and bboxArea used for tie-breaking.

nodes.name: video_models.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic request/response models for the video processing API: ViolationModel, CrewMember, VideoUploadRequest (with tripId validation), VideoProcessingResponse, and VideoProcessingError.

nodes.name: VideoUploadRequest
nodes.summary: Request model for the /process-and-upload endpoint: tripId, LP/ALP crew lists, train number, trip date; validates non-empty tripId.

nodes.name: VideoProcessingResponse
nodes.summary: Response payload returned from a completed video processing run: run directory, activities.json path, count, violations array, and processing time.

nodes.name: ViolationModel
nodes.summary: Shape of a violation as POSTed to the external mindcoinapps API: trip metadata, time window, descriptions, file URLs, crew name, and status.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package initializer that re-exports ActivityRepository for module-level imports.

nodes.name: activity_repository.py
nodes.summary: Repository abstraction for activities.json IO: atomic save with numpy-safe encoder, load with validation, latest-run-directory discovery, run-directory provisioning, and per-type summary computation.

nodes.name: parse_time_to_seconds
nodes.summary: Tolerant time parser: accepts numeric seconds, 'HH:MM:SS(.fff)', or 'MM:SS(.fff)' strings and returns a float; returns 0.0 on parse failure.

nodes.name: ActivityRepository
nodes.summary: CRUD facade over activities.json: save_activities (via atomic_write_json), load_activities, get_latest_run_dir, validate_activities (ActivityModel round-trip), create_run_directory, and get_activity_summary.

nodes.name: concurrent_activity_grouping_service.py
nodes.summary: Post-processing service that groups same-minute, same-role activities into a single combined record, merging video clips via ffmpeg concat and consolidating evidence/timestamps.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses defaultdict keyed by (minute, role) for grouping and subprocess ffmpeg with a concat-list file for clip merging.

nodes.name: ConcurrentActivityGroupingService
nodes.summary: Implements minute-bucket grouping of concurrent activities for the same role and merges them into a combined record with unioned types/evidence and an ffmpeg-concatenated clip.

nodes.name: get_concurrent_grouping_service
nodes.summary: Module-level accessor returning the singleton ConcurrentActivityGroupingService used by the multiprocessing orchestrator.

nodes.name: json_utils.py
nodes.summary: Numpy-aware JSON utilities: NumpyEncoder (handles np scalars + arrays) and atomic_write_json (portalocker file lock + tempfile + os.replace) used everywhere activities.json is persisted.
nodes.languageNotes: Crash-safe write pattern: write to mkstemp in target dir, fsync, os.replace; locks via portalocker to coordinate writers across threads and processes.

nodes.name: NumpyEncoder
nodes.summary: Custom json.JSONEncoder.default that converts numpy scalars via .item() and ndarrays via .tolist(), the project-wide workaround for numpy types in detector outputs.

nodes.name: atomic_write_json
nodes.summary: Atomically writes payload as JSON: acquires a portalocker lock, writes to a temp file in the same directory with fsync, then os.replace into target; cleans up temp file on failure.

nodes.name: multiprocessing_config.py
nodes.summary: MultiprocessingConfig dataclass with worker count derivation, environment-variable propagation (OMP_NUM_THREADS, MKL, OpenCV/OpenCL toggles) and model preload paths for chunked video processing workers.

nodes.name: MultiprocessingConfig
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding all per-worker tuning: max_workers, chunk_duration_seconds, overlap_seconds, thread caps, OpenCL flag, YOLO model paths, and GPU batch settings; provides get_num_workers and set_worker_env_vars.

nodes.name: get_default_config
nodes.summary: Factory that returns a default MultiprocessingConfig populated from pydantic Settings.

nodes.name: video_multiprocessing.py
nodes.summary: Pass-1 parallel chunked video processing: builds FrameRange chunks with overlap, runs a ProcessPoolExecutor of worker_initializer-bootstrapped workers, then sequentially merges/groups results in the main process for deterministic output.
nodes.languageNotes: Worker bootstrap eagerly loads YOLO + pose + detectors in each child process; shared pool guarded by a module-level lock and atexit cleanup to amortize startup.

nodes.name: FrameRange
nodes.summary: Dataclass describing one parallel work unit: start/end frame and time, expected sampled frames, range_id, and per-range overlap_start_frame/time for temporal continuity.

nodes.name: ProcessingState
nodes.summary: Mutable progress snapshot persisted across workers: total/processed frame counts, completed/failed ranges, start/last_update times, done flag and error_message, with to_dict/from_dict for checkpointing.

nodes.name: VideoMultiprocessingOrchestrator
nodes.summary: Top-level driver that initializes the worker pool, submits FrameRange tasks, gathers results with as_completed, sorts/merges activities via the grouping service, persists the activities.json, and saves checkpoint state.

nodes.name: worker_initializer
nodes.summary: Per-child-process bootstrap: tunes torch/cv2 threads, disables OpenCL, loads YOLO + pose + ROI models, MediaPipe FaceMesh, image preprocessing service, and all per-activity detectors so workers start hot.

nodes.name: get_shared_pool
nodes.summary: Lazily constructs and caches a process-wide ProcessPoolExecutor with the worker_initializer; registers an atexit cleanup to avoid leaked subprocesses.

nodes.name: shutdown_shared_pool
nodes.summary: Shuts down the cached shared ProcessPoolExecutor, optionally waiting for in-flight tasks.

nodes.name: calculate_frame_ranges
nodes.summary: Reads video metadata via cv2 and partitions the video into FrameRange chunks of chunk_duration with overlap_seconds head room for temporal continuity at boundaries.

nodes.name: process_frame_range
nodes.summary: Worker entrypoint: instantiates a LocopilotActivityMonitor, calls process_video_range on the assigned FrameRange, and returns the raw per-chunk activities for main-process merging.

nodes.name: _parse_video_start_seconds
nodes.summary: Internal helper to coerce a video_start_time value (int/float/HH:MM:SS string) into seconds for offset arithmetic.

nodes.name: test_activity_config_registry_view.py
nodes.summary: Pytest regression that activity_tracker observes registry mutations: monkeypatches ACTIVITY_REGISTRY and asserts a fresh ActivityTracker picks up the new min_duration via get_threshold.

nodes.name: test_tracker_observes_registry_min_duration_change
nodes.summary: Verifies that mutating ACTIVITY_REGISTRY at runtime is immediately reflected in ActivityTracker.get_threshold values for the modified activity.

nodes.name: test_atomic_write.py
nodes.summary: Pytest suite covering atomic_write_json: numpy scalar/array serialization, concurrent thread + process writers, and crash-mid-write guarantees that the original file is preserved with no stray temp files.

nodes.name: test_atomic_write_handles_numpy_scalars_and_arrays
nodes.summary: Asserts atomic_write_json round-trips numpy bool/float32/int64 scalars and ndarrays into plain JSON-compatible values.

nodes.name: test_concurrent_writes_never_leave_a_corrupt_file
nodes.summary: Stress test running two threads writing to the same target via atomic_write_json and asserting the file ends parseable and matches a writer's payload shape.

nodes.name: test_concurrent_processes_never_corrupt_the_file
nodes.summary: Cross-process variant: spawns multiprocessing.Process writers via _process_writer and asserts the final JSON is valid and produced by one of them.

nodes.name: test_crash_mid_write_preserves_original_file
nodes.summary: Patches os.replace to raise mid-write and asserts the original target file is untouched and no temp files remain in the directory.

nodes.name: test_crash_during_json_dump_preserves_original_file
nodes.summary: Forces an unserializable object through atomic_write_json and asserts the original file content survives and no temp residue is left behind.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package barrel that re-exports the six Pipeline-1 rule-engine detectors (activity, gesture, mind diversion, object, sleep, train motion) so callers can import them from a single namespace.

nodes.name: activity_detector.py
nodes.summary: Pipeline-1 rule engine for writing posture, hand-near-book proximity, cell-phone-in-hand, and packing-bag wrist-motion detection; aggregates keypoint-based geometry and per-person motion history.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses defaultdict-backed per-person motion deques and getattr-based threshold injection from pydantic Settings.

nodes.name: gesture_detector.py
nodes.summary: Pipeline-1 hand-gesture detector implementing a raise-hold-lower trajectory state machine, LP/ALP gesture-coordination sessions, RTMW hand-shape integration, and velocity-based FP suppression.
nodes.languageNotes: Maintains per-person hand-position deques and gesture-session expiry; nested calculate_velocity closure inside analyze_hand_velocity.

nodes.name: mind_diversion_detector.py
nodes.summary: Detects locomotive-pilot inattention by computing head yaw/pitch from facial keypoints (ear-asymmetry + optional face-mesh refinement) and flagging sustained gaze toward the cabin window vs forward.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses numpy linalg for ear-eye geometry and an optional MediaPipe face-mesh refinement path.

nodes.name: object_detector.py
nodes.summary: Facade over the YOLO handler that adds ROI extraction around pose keypoints, aspect-ratio validation, batched multi-person/multi-ROI inference, zone suppression, and optional SAHI sliced inference.

nodes.name: pose_geometry.py
nodes.summary: Pure pose-geometry helpers for the sleep detector: keypoint lookup, landmark validation, head tilt angle, movement scoring, wrist-distance computation, and body-movement aggregation.

nodes.name: train_motion_detector.py
nodes.summary: Vibration- and window-flow-based detector that classifies the train cabin as RUNNING/STOPPED/UNCERTAIN; outputs the motion gate used by gates.py to suppress non-safety-critical activities at stations.
nodes.languageNotes: Combines per-frame absdiff vibration, Farneback optical flow on a window ROI, and block-variance stability with smoothed state history.

nodes.name: multi_person_runner.py
nodes.summary: MultiPersonActivityRunner — the 1200-line per-frame multi-person detector dispatcher extracted from LocopilotActivityMonitor; runs YOLO + pose + all rule engines and aggregates per-person triggers.
nodes.languageNotes: Single giant run() method delegates back to the monitor instance via a thin wrapper pattern.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package barrel re-exporting PersonTracker so consumers can import from app.core.tracking directly.

nodes.name: person_tracker.py
nodes.summary: PersonTracker assigns and maintains LP/ALP roles across frames using IoU-based temporal tracking, bbox-size heuristics, and pose-to-detection matching with stale-state cleanup.

nodes.name: static_object_filter.py
nodes.summary: Filters out objects (phones, backpacks) that remain spatially static across N frames to suppress FPs from fixed cabin fixtures (mounted phones, stowed bags).

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Utility-package barrel re-exporting geometry helpers (IoU, bbox overlap, deduplication) and pose helpers (keypoint lookup, wrist distance).

nodes.name: geometry.py
nodes.summary: Bbox geometry helpers shared across detectors and trackers: IoU computation, person-object overlap with configurable margin, and IoU-based person-box deduplication.

nodes.name: pose_utils.py
nodes.summary: Shared pose helpers: canonical keypoint lookup across yolo/rtmpose/rtmw landmark schemas, and the inter-wrist distance calculator parameterized by visibility thresholds.

nodes.name: test_static_object_filter.py
nodes.summary: Pytest suite for StaticObjectFilter covering static-suppression after min-frames, disabled-filter passthrough, empty inputs, and byte-identical phone/backpack log strings.

nodes.name: ActivityDetector
nodes.summary: Rule engine combining keypoint-derived posture (writing), hand-object bbox proximity (book, cell phone, backpack), and per-person packing-motion analysis into discrete activity flags.

nodes.name: GestureDetector
nodes.summary: Detects raised-hand gestures with control-zone gating, temporal suppression, LP/ALP coordination sessions, RTMW hand-shape backup, and velocity-trajectory FP filtering.

nodes.name: MindDiversionDetector
nodes.summary: Estimates head yaw/pitch from ear-eye geometry (with optional face-mesh refinement) and flags sustained off-axis gaze toward the window while suppressing during writing or forward-looking exemptions.

nodes.name: ObjectDetector
nodes.summary: Thin facade around YOLOHandler exposing ROI extraction, aspect-ratio validation, batched multi-person ROI detection, and pose-guided ROI inference for per-keypoint targeted detection.

nodes.name: TrainMotionDetector
nodes.summary: Per-frame train-motion classifier fusing interior-masked vibration, window-ROI optical flow, and block-variance stability into a smoothed RUNNING/STOPPED/UNCERTAIN state.

nodes.name: MultiPersonActivityRunner
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the per-frame multi-person Pipeline-1 loop: pose, object detection, role assignment, all rule-engine dispatches, and aggregation of triggering persons per activity.

nodes.name: PersonTracker
nodes.summary: Assigns LP/ALP/passenger roles to detected persons using bbox-size heuristics, maintains role identity across frames via IoU temporal tracking, and matches pose results to role-tagged bboxes.

nodes.name: StaticObjectFilter
nodes.summary: Tracks candidate object bboxes by IoU across frames and suppresses any detection that remains static for min_frames, emitting suppression logs in a byte-identical format for both phone and backpack.

nodes.name: validate_pose_landmarks
nodes.summary: Validates a pose-landmarks payload by checking landmark count and per-keypoint visibility against detector-supplied minima.

nodes.name: calculate_head_tilt_angle
nodes.summary: Computes the head-tilt angle from nose/shoulder geometry using arctan2, used by the sleep state machine to detect head drops.

nodes.name: calculate_movement_score
nodes.summary: Quantifies inter-frame movement by averaging keypoint displacements between the previous and current landmark sets.

nodes.name: calculate_wrist_distance
nodes.summary: Computes inter-wrist Euclidean distance after validating pose landmarks; delegates to the shared pose-utils canonical implementation.

nodes.name: _calculate_body_movement
nodes.summary: Aggregates per-keypoint movement across selected body indices to produce an overall body-movement score used in drowsy-state evaluation.

nodes.name: calculate_iou
nodes.summary: Computes Intersection-over-Union for two axis-aligned bboxes, returning 0.0 for empty intersections; the core IoU primitive used across tracking and detector code.

nodes.name: bbox_overlap_with_margin
nodes.summary: Tests whether an object bbox overlaps a person bbox after expanding the person bbox by a configurable pixel margin; used for hand-object proximity.

nodes.name: deduplicate_person_boxes
nodes.summary: Removes overlapping person detections via IoU-based NMS while preserving the highest-area boxes, with an optional min-area filter.

nodes.name: get_keypoint
nodes.summary: Canonical keypoint accessor that maps human-readable names (e.g., 'left_wrist') to the right index across yolo, rtmpose, and rtmw landmark schemas.

nodes.name: calculate_wrist_distance
nodes.summary: Computes inter-wrist pixel distance with visibility-aware fallbacks (single wrist + shoulder, elbow extrapolation) parameterized by per-keypoint visibility thresholds.

nodes.name: _zero_disabled
nodes.summary: Zeros out per-person activity flags whose activity key is disabled in the global activity_registry, ensuring suppressed activities never leak through downstream aggregation.

nodes.name: test_static_suppression_after_min_frames
nodes.summary: Verifies StaticObjectFilter suppresses a static phone detection after the configured min_frames threshold is reached.

nodes.name: test_phone_log_string_byte_identical
nodes.summary: Regression test ensuring StaticObjectFilter emits the exact byte-identical suppression log string for phone objects (grep-friendliness contract).

nodes.name: test_backpack_log_string_byte_identical
nodes.summary: Regression test ensuring StaticObjectFilter emits the exact byte-identical suppression log string for backpack objects.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package barrel for HTTP middleware components; re-exports LoggingMiddleware so callers can import it from app.middleware directly.
nodes.languageNotes: Python package barrel using a relative import to surface a single middleware class.

nodes.name: logging_middleware.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI ASGI middleware that establishes per-request logging context (request id, sanitized auth flag, headers, timing) and emits structured request/response/error log lines.
nodes.languageNotes: BaseHTTPMiddleware.dispatch wraps call_next in a try/except/finally so request-scoped context is reset even on errors.

nodes.name: LoggingMiddleware
nodes.summary: Starlette BaseHTTPMiddleware subclass that records request start time, populates ContextVar-based request context with redacted auth markers, and logs success/failure with duration in seconds.

nodes.name: image_encoder.py
nodes.summary: Low-level image utilities for the VLM verifier: base64-encodes JPEGs and detects/crops a person+object region of interest using HSV color masks before sending the strip to Qwen2.5-VL.
nodes.languageNotes: ROI detection composites two HSV color masks (typical bbox-overlay colors) and returns the union bounding rectangle of contours above an area threshold.

nodes.name: _detect_roi
nodes.summary: Detects the union bounding rectangle of green/red overlay contours on a frame, used to find the YOLO-drawn person+object region before cropping.

nodes.name: _crop_to_roi
nodes.summary: Crops an image to its detected ROI with configurable padding; returns the original frame untouched when no ROI is found.

nodes.name: keyframe_processor.py
nodes.summary: Pipeline-2 keyframe utilities: resolves existing JPEGs for an activity, supplements them by reading additional frames from the source clip, counts person/object bboxes, and stitches keyframes into a single VLM input strip with optional ROI cropping.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses cv2.VideoCapture to seek frame offsets relative to a saved keyframe anchor when not enough keyframes are pre-extracted.

nodes.name: _resolve_keyframes
nodes.summary: Resolves an activity's keyframe JPEG paths from its evidenceFrames list and falls back to the keyframeImage field when the list is empty or paths are missing.

nodes.name: _supplement_keyframes_from_clip
nodes.summary: Tops up the keyframe set to target_n by seeking evenly spaced frames from the activity's source clip when fewer JPEGs were saved upstream.

nodes.name: _count_bboxes_in_keyframes
nodes.summary: Counts how many keyframes contain at least one person-box (green overlay) and one object-box (red overlay) above area thresholds, used to gate full-frame vs ROI-cropped VLM strips.

nodes.name: _stitch_keyframes
nodes.summary: Composes the keyframe burst into a single horizontal or vertical strip with FRAME-N labels, optional ROI cropping, and a max strip width so the encoded JPEG stays within VLM input limits.

nodes.name: motion_classifier.py
nodes.summary: OCR-based camera detection plus per-camera window-region frame-diff motion classifier; runs before the VLM call to drop train-stationary writing/eating false positives that vibration detection and the VLM text both miss.
nodes.languageNotes: Camera ID is parsed loosely from EasyOCR output to absorb common character substitutions (CAB->CAU, ALP->ALR, camera->amera/era).

nodes.name: _get_easyocr_reader
nodes.summary: Lazily constructs and caches a single EasyOCR English reader (CPU mode) used for cabin-camera ID detection.

nodes.name: detect_camera_id
nodes.summary: Runs EasyOCR on the bottom-right overlay strip of a single keyframe and maps the recognized text to LP_CAM2 / ALP_CAM3 via tolerant regex patterns.

nodes.name: detect_camera_for_video
nodes.summary: Iterates keyframes for a given source video filename and returns the first successfully detected camera id, caching the result for subsequent activities of the same clip.

nodes.name: compute_window_motion_score
nodes.summary: Computes the median per-pair pixel diff inside the camera-specific window ROI across consecutive keyframes; low scores indicate the cabin window is static (train stopped).

nodes.name: parse_roi_overrides_from_settings
nodes.summary: Parses optional 'x1,y1,x2,y2' window-ROI overrides from settings for LP and ALP cameras, allowing operators to retune ROIs without redeploying.

nodes.name: classify_motion
nodes.summary: Top-level entry that resolves camera id (preferring an explicit camera_angle, falling back to OCR), selects the matching window ROI, and returns a structured motion verdict the VLM service can act on.

nodes.name: service.py
nodes.summary: Heart of the Pipeline-2 VLM verifier: orchestrates per-activity prompts, subtype expansion/aggregation, async HTTP calls to vLLM (Qwen2.5-VL-7B-AWQ) with a circuit breaker, window-motion and speedometer pre-checks, verdict calibration, and JSONL telemetry.
nodes.languageNotes: Mixes sync and async entry points: verify_activities runs verify_activities_async in a worker thread when called from synchronous loops, while still reusing the async httpx client pool.

nodes.name: VlmVerificationService
nodes.summary: Stateless verifier service that filters Pipeline-1 activities by sending keyframes + activity-specific prompts to a vLLM endpoint, aggregating subtype verdicts back into parent activities, and attaching vlm_review blocks; fail-open on any vLLM error.

nodes.name: get_vlm_verification_service
nodes.summary: Module-level accessor returning a process-wide VlmVerificationService instance, lazily constructed on first call.

nodes.name: speedometer_classifier.py
nodes.summary: Per-camera speedometer-ROI frame-diff classifier; complements the window-motion classifier by inspecting the dashboard speedometer panel to confirm whether the train is moving.

nodes.name: compute_speedometer_motion_score
nodes.summary: Reads keyframes, computes consecutive grayscale absolute-diff means inside the per-camera speedometer ROI, and returns the median diff plus per-pair scores and timing metadata.

nodes.name: classify_motion
nodes.summary: High-level wrapper around compute_speedometer_motion_score that picks the camera-specific ROI from overrides or defaults and yields a clean STOPPED/MOVING verdict with confidence.

nodes.name: parse_roi_overrides_from_settings
nodes.summary: Parses optional LP/ALP speedometer-ROI 'x1,y1,x2,y2' strings from Settings so operators can retune ROIs without redeploying code.

nodes.name: verdict_parser.py
nodes.summary: VLM verdict post-processing: parses JSON (with code-fence tolerance and regex salvage for truncated responses), runs per-object-type consistency checks, and exposes a calibrator that re-maps raw model confidences via configurable mappings.
nodes.languageNotes: Salvage path uses regex to recover {verdict, confidence, reasoning} when JSON is truncated past the closing brace, returning a salvage flag so callers can downgrade confidence.

nodes.name: _Calibrator
nodes.summary: Lazy-loaded JSON-backed confidence calibrator supporting identity, clip, log-linear, and piecewise-linear mappings, optionally per object_type.

nodes.name: _append_jsonl
nodes.summary: Thread-safe append of a single record to a JSONL telemetry file, creating parent directories as needed and serializing one JSON object per line.

nodes.name: _consistency_check
nodes.summary: Per-object-type rule engine that flips contradictory VLM verdicts (e.g. claims writing but says hand_actually_on_book=false) and emits a structured list of consistency reasons; central source of secondary truth for the verifier.

nodes.name: _has_hard_stopped_cue
nodes.summary: Scans VLM motion-evidence text for explicit stopped cues (e.g. 'no visible motion', 'platform visible') while excluding negated clauses, used to corroborate STOPPED verdicts.

nodes.name: _parse_verdict
nodes.summary: Robust JSON parser for VLM completion text: strips ```code-fences```, repairs missing closing braces, and falls back to regex extraction of verdict/confidence/reasoning when JSON parse fails so a truncated response is still actionable.

nodes.name: _safe_motion_state
nodes.summary: Reconciles the upstream Pipeline-1 motionState with the VLM-reported train_appears_to_be, returning a final motion classification used downstream for evidence flagging.

nodes.name: vlm_client.py
nodes.summary: Minimal HTTP-failure circuit breaker for the VLM verifier: opens after N consecutive failures, stays open for a cooldown window, and resets on success, ensuring vLLM outages fail-open without spamming requests.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses time.monotonic and a threading.Lock to coordinate state across the verifier's async tasks and sync fallback thread.

nodes.name: _CircuitBreaker
nodes.summary: Threading-safe circuit breaker tracking consecutive failures with an open-state cooldown; exposes is_open(), record_failure(), record_success(), and reset() used by VlmVerificationService.

nodes.name: yolo_pose_adapter.py
nodes.summary: Adapter that wraps Ultralytics YOLOv8 pose model output behind a MediaPipe-style landmark interface so downstream detectors can switch between yolo/rtmpose/rtmw backends without code changes.
nodes.languageNotes: Adapter pattern: YoloPoseAdapter.process returns a list of PersonKeypoints exposing pose_landmarks and bbox in the same shape RTMPose/RTMW adapters use.

nodes.name: YoloLandmark
nodes.summary: Lightweight value object holding a single normalized keypoint (x, y, z, visibility) with a debug-friendly __repr__; mirrors the MediaPipe NormalizedLandmark interface.

nodes.name: YoloPoseLandmarks
nodes.summary: Container that converts Ultralytics keypoint tensors into a list of YoloLandmark and exposes them via index access, falling back to padded landmarks when YOLO emits fewer than 17 points.

nodes.name: YoloPoseAdapter
nodes.summary: Loads a YOLOv8 pose checkpoint (resolving model path from env), runs inference on a frame, and returns PersonKeypoints for each detected person with bbox and adapter-uniform landmarks.

nodes.name: PersonKeypoints
nodes.summary: Per-person result aggregating pose_landmarks, bbox, and confidence; the canonical return shape consumed by all activity detectors.

tour.title: Project Overview & Architecture
tour.description: Start with CLAUDE.md — the canonical architecture and operations guide for the Locopilot Monitoring System. It explains the two-pipeline design: Pipeline 1 (classical CV with YOLO, pose, per-detector rules, train-motion gate, and temporal filter) feeds Pipeline 2 (VLM verification via Qwen2.5-VL-7B-AWQ on vLLM at :8001), with confirmed violations uploaded to S3 and posted to the customer's mindcoinapps API. Read this first to understand WHY the codebase is structured the way it is.

tour.title: FastAPI Entry Point & Gunicorn Boot
tour.description: app/main.py is the production entrypoint — it is the FastAPI application factory that wires the lifespan context, middleware, controllers, and the per-process GPU singleton. gunicorn_config.py enforces the project's load-bearing invariant of workers=1, because every GPU model (YOLO, MediaPipe pose, and the VLM client) is a per-process singleton that cannot be safely shared across workers. Together these files explain how the server actually starts.
tour.languageLesson: FastAPI uses an async lifespan context manager (yield-based) to run startup/shutdown code around the application's lifetime. This is how the project initializes the GPU singleton exactly once per worker process.

tour.title: HTTP Controller & Async Job Queue
tour.description: Building on the FastAPI app from Step 2, video_controller.py exposes the /api/video/analyze and /api/video/process-and-upload routes that accept a video URL and either run synchronously or enqueue an async job. job_manager.py implements the in-process job queue with a single-worker dispatcher — this is where requests are serialized before they ever touch the GPU. This pair is the seam between HTTP and the heavy CV pipeline.

tour.title: Pipeline 1 — Frame Processing Orchestration
tour.description: video_processing_service.py is the top-level coordinator for Pipeline 1: it opens the video, drives the deterministic two-pass loop, and hands frames to multi_person_runner.py, which extracts each detected person crop and runs the per-person detector stack. This is the heart of the classical-CV pipeline — recently extracted from the 3,200-line LocopilotActivityMonitor monolith during the 2026-05-09 architecture cleanup.

tour.title: Activity Registry & Train-Motion Gate
tour.description: activity_registry.py is the single source of truth for every monitored activity — its thresholds, cooldowns, and per-activity train-stopped suppression policy. gates.py implements the train-motion gate: when the speedometer reads zero, activities like sleeping or phone-use that are only safety-critical while moving are suppressed. Understanding these two files is essential before reading any individual detector, because every detector reads its config from the registry and respects the gate.

tour.title: Per-Detector Rule Engines
tour.description: Each safety-critical activity has a dedicated detector that consumes the YOLO detections and pose landmarks for a single person crop. activity_detector.py routes per-frame inputs to the right detector; gesture_detector.py recognizes hand-signal poses; train_motion_detector.py reads the speedometer; mind_diversion_detector.py flags head-orientation drift; object_detector.py wraps the YOLO object inference. Together these implement Pipeline 1's classification logic — pure, testable rule functions.

tour.title: Sleep Detector Subsystem (post-split)
tour.description: Sleep is the most complex detector and was extracted into its own package during the 2026-05-09 cleanup (spec 0006). detector.py is the public entry; state_machine.py runs the eyes-closed -> microsleep -> sleep transition logic with hysteresis; pose_geometry.py provides the pure geometric primitives (head-tilt, eye-aspect-ratio) the state machine consumes. This is the cleanest example in the codebase of breaking a god-class into a stateful core, a pure-math helper, and a thin facade.
tour.languageLesson: A finite state machine pattern is used here because sleep detection has temporal hysteresis — single noisy frames must not flip the verdict. The state machine separates 'what state are we in' from 'how do we measure each frame', which is why pose_geometry stays pure-function.

tour.title: Pipeline 2 — VLM Verification
tour.description: Once Pipeline 1 nominates a candidate violation, Pipeline 2 verifies it with a multimodal LLM to suppress false positives. service.py is the orchestrator; keyframe_processor.py picks representative frames from the violation window; vlm_client.py calls the local vLLM server hosting Qwen2.5-VL-7B-AWQ on port 8001; verdict_parser.py extracts the structured YES/NO verdict from free-text output; motion_classifier.py (added 2026-05-10) does an OCR-based window-region check to suppress alerts when the train is at a station. This package was split out of a 2,486-line god-class (spec 0002).

tour.title: Egress — S3 Upload & External API
tour.description: After Pipeline 2 confirms a violation, the evidence clip and metadata are uploaded to S3 by s3_upload_service.py, and a structured alert is POSTed to the customer's mindcoinapps endpoint by external_api_service.py. This is the final stage of the pipeline — the only place the system communicates with the outside world. Understanding this layer matters because retry/idempotency semantics here directly affect billing and the customer's downstream dashboard.

tour.title: Configuration & Runtime Settings
tour.description: app/utils/config.py is the pydantic-settings hub that every other module reads from — it appears in the top-3 fan-in across the whole codebase. .env.example documents every available knob: VLM endpoint, S3 credentials, detector thresholds, gunicorn worker count, and the external API key. Reading these two together gives you the complete list of dials operators can turn without redeploying.

tour.title: Build, Deploy & CI
tour.description: start_server.sh is the local-dev launcher that creates a venv and starts gunicorn; deploy-gpu.sh rsyncs the project to the GPU server (admin1@103.116.80.162:/opt/p...) and restarts the systemd unit. The pip-audit GitHub Actions workflow guards the supply chain by running pip-audit in strict mode against the hashed requirements lockfile on every PR. Together these explain how code goes from a developer laptop to the production GPU box.
tour.languageLesson: Hash-pinned requirements (requirements.lock with --require-hashes) combined with pip-audit in CI is a defense-in-depth pattern: the lockfile guarantees byte-identical installs, while pip-audit catches known CVEs in those exact pinned versions before they reach production.

tour.title: Determinism Contract & Legacy Monolith
tour.description: test_determinism.py enforces the project's load-bearing two-pass deterministic pipeline — running the same video twice must produce byte-identical activity output (this was restored by spec 0001 in code-review-fixes). locopilot_monitor.py is the original 3,147-line monolith that has been progressively decomposed into the app/ package; it now survives as a thin orchestrator and a reference for behavior the new modules must preserve. End the tour here to appreciate where this codebase came from and the safety net that keeps refactors honest.
